description:
The World in 2050, After World War III | Sci-Fi Movie 4K. In 2050, twenty-four years after World War III, the survivors live by one rule: don't look up. Thirty-meter machines called Collectors walk the ash wastelands, and anyone who looks up is carried off to EDEN, the shining city of Halden Cross, where three days later their memory is erased forever. When a Collector takes her father, Lena has 72 hours to get him back, and her only guide is a battered war robot she digs out of the sand, in a world that believes a machine started the war. The World in 2050, After World War III is a post-apocalyptic science fiction movie about a daughter who would cross a dead world for her father, and a machine that knows more about the night the missiles flew than anyone alive. It's about who we blame for our wars, what one lie can cost, and a question that feels closer every year: if a machine told the truth and a man lied, which one would we believe? And the final scene asks the survivors to do the one thing no one has dared to do in twenty-four years.
An original sci-fi movie written and produced by FANTASY MOVIE KINGDOM, with visuals and voices created using AI tools. For the best experience, watch in 4K, then tell us in the comments: would you have trusted the robot?
